steps.message:
Finish this standalone English tweet naturally, maintaining its stance and casual voice. Do not repeat the prefix, invent a link or hashtag, or discuss this task. Use roughly 16 words; the full tweet including the prefix must be at most 280 characters. Output only the remaining text.

Prefix:
Tiny perfect storm for #CAD this 

Use tools to write only the requested answer to /app/answer.txt. Do not search the web. The final chat reply may briefly confirm completion.

The user wants to complete a tweet that starts with "Tiny perfect storm for #CAD this". The tweet is about Canadian CAD. "CAD" is the hashtag — "Tiny perfect storm for #CAD this ...". #CAD is likely the Canadian dollar ticker. So the completion should be about the November Canadian dollar. For example, "month: weak USD, oil up, BoC cut priced out" — about 16 words.

Prefix: "Tiny perfect storm for #CAD this " (with trailing space). The remaining text is about 16 words. No hashtags, no links.

Options: "month, oil holding up, dollars easing and rate cut fully priced in" — count: month(1), oil(2), holding(3) up(4), dollars(5) easing(6) and(7) rate(8) cut(9) fully(10) priced(11) in(12) — 12 words. Need about 16 words.

"month: crude up, US dollar slipping, BoC cut priced in and risk on" — month(1) crude(2) up(3) US(4) dollar(5) slipping(6) BoC(7) cut(8) priced(9) in(10) and(11) risk(12) on(13) — 13 words. Adding "season" makes 14.

"month for it: crude firm, US slipping, BoC cut fully priced and risk on" — for(1) it(2): crude(3) firm(4) US(5) slipping(6) BoC(7) cut(8) fully(9) priced(10) and(11) risk(12) on(13). 13 words.

Aim for around 16 words. "month: crude up, US easing, BoC cut priced in, risk on and no rates til dec" — month(1) crude(2) up(3) US(4) easing(5) BoC(6) cut(7) priced(8) in(9) risk(10) on(11) and(12) no(13) rates(14) til(15) dec(16) — 16 words. The casual voice is good.

Character count: prefix "Tiny perfect storm for #CAD this " = counting it: "Tiny perfect storm for #CAD this " — Tiny(4)+1+perfect(7)+1+storm(5)+1+for(3)+1+#CAD(4)+1+this(4)+1 = 4+1+7+1+5+1+3+1+4+1+4+1 = 33 characters. The remaining part: "month: crude up, US easing, BoC cut priced in, risk on and no rates til dec" — roughly: month:(6)+1+crude(5)+1+up,(3)+1+US(2)+1+easing,(7)+1+BoC(3)+1+cut(3)+1+priced(6)+1+in,(3)+1+risk(4)+1+on(2)+1+and(3)+1+no(2)+1+rates(5)+1+til(3)+1+dec(3) = 6+1+5+1+3+1+2+1+7+1+3+1+3+1+6+1+3+1+4+1+2+1+3+1+2+1+5+1+3+1+3 = doing the sum: 6+1=7, +5=12, +1=13, +3=16, +1=17, +2=19, +1=20, +7=27, +1=28, +3=31, +1=32, +3=35, +1=36, +6=42, +1=43, +3=46, +1=47, +4=51, +1=52, +2=54, +1=55, +3=58, +1=59, +2=61, +1=62, +5=67, +1=68, +3=71, +1=72, +3=75. Total 33+75=108, which is well under 280. Good.

Write it to /app/answer.txt.
